argv.meaning: Complete argument vector beginning with /usr/local/bin/harmonia. Accepted tails are update (alone, with --apply, or with --check), interactable list --json, interactable run/silence/unsilence ID, and update-module /etc/harmonia/profiles/PROFILE/index.json --module ID with an optional final --apply. ID consists of one or more ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens; PROFILE consists of one or more lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens.

invocation_id.meaning: Lowercase UUID v4 used to correlate the transient service’s exit footer.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Only a pre-handoff refusal is a staff receipt. Once exec succeeds, the stop is replaced by systemd-run and the child owns stdout, stderr and exit status.
